decisive_items: a well-defined T1-hypointense, STIR-hyperintense lesion with a thick sclerotic rim in the anterolateral cortex of the left femoral head
mild to moderate chronic synovitis with lymphoplasmacytic infiltrates
response.rationale: R2 is the champion because its label, Synovial Sarcoma, is supported by the patient's histology and imaging findings, which are consistent with a rare type of cancer that can cause synovitis and bone lesions. R3, Chronic Recurrent Multifocal Osteomyelitis (CRMO), is the runner-up because it also has some supporting evidence, but the champion has more specific and high-priority assessments.
